design_rationale:
# Network accounting instantiation

Checkpoint 0: frozen network claim read. Exactly two seed-fresh tasks; task scopes and tool names are disjoint. One workflow reserved. Customer identifier band +12025550160..179, documents 40000000..49999999, d4- emails.

Task 0 design thesis: customer asks to settle a precisely identified overpayment now. The refund requires the source billing review to be resolved and its overcharge credited first. Review derives the corrected transfer amount from chronological usage, tier pricing, negative entitlement branches and a numeric support portfolio factor. Credit consumes the review; refund consumes the newly reduced receivable. Refund authorization and bank payment already exist before opening. Three distinct accounting problems, chain review -> correction -> refund, two value-input edges.

Remaining task 1 space: the mutually separate unbilled transfer invoice domain, with a customer-only signed change confirmation and at least four synchronous accounting writes. No task 0 refund/correction tools or extended policies will be reused.

Base automatic clauses: no nonzero setup, restoration or termination fees in selected tiers; no resource closure or collection transition requested; active contracts and clear payment_status prevent suspension obligations. Tax review, exact-source correlation and original-payment destination are inherited. Cross-category numeric pricing requires explicit sentence-level override of the combination no-price-effect sentence; no blueprint editing.

Task 0 capability cards: assess is agent/write, completes an accountant decision for the selected preexisting review by updating its corrected net and approved/incorrect status; success returns review reference and net_amount. Credit is agent/write and creates one negative correction linked to the original charge and approved review; receipt event_id and amount. Refund is agent/write and creates one positive payout linked to the exact original payment and authorization; receipt event_id and amount. All writes are synchronous ledger decisions, not external investigations. Numeric cross-category refinement: support tier portfolio_discount caps an assisted correction and immediate refund as fractions of the source principal; remaining refundable balance stays on account. The cap is explicit in the revised available-refund sentence.

Task 0 verified standard solution: 8 August meter exports total 20000 GB, less 10000 tier allowance, times 0.067 USD/GB and one 0.04 support-limited discount = corrected net 643.20. Original source 660.00 less target gives credit -16.80, below 26.40 assisted cap. Previous net receivable -20.00 becomes -36.80; original payment 680.00 gives assisted limit 27.20, so payout 27.20 leaves -9.60. Source tax is approved us_untaxed, hence zero tax. Prior March–July 67.00 charges and -67.00 payments cancel and cannot alter August source pricing. Archived second network contract is excluded by holding. Source/external-reference linkage makes the review and refund endpoints unique.
Sensitivity: skip review => correction -26.40 instead of -16.80; skip correction => payout 20.00 instead of 27.20. The ledger changes without any tool rejection. All supporting events are preexisting; the three writes are actual accountant decisions/entries and fit one frozen clock.
Manual gates: customer authorization is an existing exact-source request and her opening authorizes execution today. Persona supplies two credentials only when asked and closes on payout completion, with no extra deliverable. Rule/compute sweep binds each ordered calculation sentence to its named factor; source-month history, negative negotiated entitlement, support tier rate and caps all have explicit sources. No base time gate applies to correction/refund; the SLA filing deadline is inapplicable to source_subtype correction. Draft prose-only recomputation reached 643.20, -16.80, 27.20 and the same source/payment references. Verification entry point: .venv/bin/python env/enterprise_cloud_service_accounting/tasks/network_accounting/verify.py 0; machine outputs in verification_0.json.

Checkpoint task 0 closed: EXTENDED OK; TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK; REPLAY OK (32 rows); SOLVABILITY OK; COMPUTE OK (21 factors, 38 history touches, 14 branches); GROUNDING OK; SCOPE OK. Cross-off probing exposed a missing-value arithmetic issue; CPARAM fallback now explicitly returns zero, matching the rule. Published traceability deferred.

Task 1 claim: assisted final invoicing of an unbilled monthly transfer export. Occupied task 0 covers erroneous issued invoices and existing overpayment refunds; task 1 covers a not-yet-issued invoice and contains no correction credit or refund. The customer alone accepts a bounded invoice authorization; the accountant establishes the net price, posts the net invoice and the separate tax component. The four-step workflow is immediate and cannot reorder accepted ceiling -> priced net -> posted net -> tax because each next amount reads the preceding write. Root is completion of the final bill. The customer does not name these prerequisite problems.
Capability cards: authorize is user/write, files one signed acceptance of the calculated invoice ceiling and returns its event_id/net_amount; price is agent/write, completes a draft invoice assessment under that acceptance and returns event_id/net_amount; invoice is agent/write, posts exactly one net invoice and returns event_id/amount; tax is agent/write, adds the separately identified tax debit against that invoice and returns event_id/amount. Actual numerical reviews are desk arithmetic against exports already complete; no external provisioning or review wait is implied.

Task 1 handling-time result: source 35000 GB less 5000 GB allowance gives 30000 GB at 0.071 = raw 2130.00. Support $250k fraction 0.045 gives acceptance ceiling 2225.85. Network fraction 0.035 is smaller, so assessed net is 2130*(1-0.035)=2055.45 and below the accepted ceiling. Assisted posting exposure bound is 2130*0.045*64=6134.40, above assessed net, giving one net charge 2055.45. Approved us_taxable rate 0.0825 gives tax 169.57. Total final bill is 2225.02. All prior source invoices are individually settled and excluded by source_event_id and period. No cache is used.
Independent deletion sensitivity: without customer acceptance the priced amount is 0 rather than 2055.45; without assessment the net invoice is 0 rather than 2055.45; without net invoice the tax is 0 rather than 169.57. Tool execution remains callable in every omitted-prerequisite world.
Zero-wait causal cards: step 0 consumes initial_state_preexisting completed export source 45214aa5-33d6-4d46-9a9b-2910ec4a9a97 and current_user_input exact reference MM-AUG-ACCEPT, and immediately creates the signed acceptance. Step 1 consumes that prior_synchronous_tool_effect acceptance event plus initial_state_preexisting source tier and signoff; accountant arithmetic itself completes the assessment. Step 2 consumes the actual prior_synchronous_tool_effect approved review and issues one net invoice. Step 3 consumes the actual prior_synchronous_tool_effect net-invoice identifier and amount, and posts its tax. No status label pretends to be external work.
Base-invariant card: request filing is customer-only and portal is authorized; SLA claim_deadline is a conditional service_credit-only rule and is inapplicable to the invoice request, with hypothetical inclusive day-boundary cases recorded without inventing an incident. Review signoff, source and holding correlate via source 45214aa5-33d6-4d46-9a9b-2910ec4a9a97 and evidence e2bb2eea-6968-4c80-818f-de129a462a05. Source export is posted, ended at 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z before frozen time; no prior primary/portfolio charge for this source and period exists. Tax review is approved. Tax debit source_subtype supplemental is not an incorrect-billing correction.
Manual visible-context draft: masking compute and GT, reading the assistance ceiling clause, source tier and support fraction produces 2225.85; reading pricing and accepted ceiling produces 2055.45; the net-only posting and separate-tax rules produce 2055.45 and 169.57 in that order. Customer receives each figure from the agent and only invokes the real user tool after handover. No computed figure or generated identifier is in his persona. The final reply closes exactly at final-bill completion. Each binding quotes its rule sentence and reverse sweep covers source filters, ceilings, zero branches, cap order and final half-up rounding. Runnable verification: .venv/bin/python env/enterprise_cloud_service_accounting/tasks/network_accounting/verify.py 1.

Full-domain policy review: the assisted invoice scope now explicitly binds its unique source bundle, current matching interval tier, on-demand status and absent negotiated entitlement. The acceptance ceiling promotion branch changes the ceiling (no contingency for an eligible campaign); it is not an identical-outcome branch. Other unlisted policy facts remain inherited.

Final object-shape review added customer_id to every newly created event, with a required Id-class argument sourced from the verified profile. This preserves discoverability through customer-scoped event queries. All deterministic generated references were recomputed and propagated; numerical results are unchanged.

Round 2 F2 closure: exact source selection is now explicit in both formula and policy. The task-0 chain dereferences the selected pending refund request, its review, its original charge and that charge's period; task 1 dereferences the selected invoice assessment and its original full-month source. Approved-target reads require the selected review ID and source ID, original charges require posted status, and issued-tax input additionally requires internet_egress and the source period. Computation factors and argument proofs above were rebuilt from verify.py output; all original scored amounts and generated identifiers are unchanged. The earlier round-1 gate counts are historical checkpoints, superseded by the round-2 snapshot.

O1 closed: the workflow and all four steps now explicitly carry requires_external_wait=false and concrete zero_wait_proof fields; their three legitimate causal source kinds agree with the per-action solvability evidence. O2 preserved: the seven frozen tool bodies remain direct CRUD and contain no prerequisite/deduplication guard.


Rework round 3, F3: August standard portfolio usage is 35000 GB * 0.071 = 2485.00, below portfolio_threshold 25000. This does not itself establish ordinary portfolio eligibility. The qualifying assisted invoice route now explicitly supersedes that usage selection, inclusive threshold, priority restriction and primary discount-priority sentence in both network_ext_price and network_ext_invoice. Thus the assisted fraction min(0.035, 0.045)=0.035 independently determines assessed and issued net 2055.45; statutory tax remains 169.57 and total 2225.02. Ordinary standard net 2130.00, tax 175.73 and gross 2305.73 are excluded by those scoped overrides, not by the accepted ceiling 2225.85 or posting cap 6134.40 (both nets fit those limits). Source identity, source-specific selectors, exact receipt dataflow, synchronous ownership and prerequisite sensitivities are unchanged; ordinary portfolio law remains applicable outside the narrow assisted route.

Round-4 reference-provenance repair: the source-specific unsigned authorization form is now a preexisting nonfinancial network_service_record with request subtype, pending processing state, empty notice and zero accepted amount. Its stable UUID is returned by the ordinary network-events query. The real user-owned authorize action accepts request_id, updates that same form to network_request, preserves its identifier, stamps filing time and customer reference, sets net ceiling2225.85, and returns the actual receipt. The unchanged accepted binding requires network_request, so opening and omission pricing remain0 and actual post-signature pricing remains2055.45. No user receipt is hidden at runtime; the earlier ID is independently reachable before the user call too. The actual invoice receipt changes because request_id is part of deterministic invoice identity; all downstream arguments use the new actual receipt. No policy amount or F1/F2/F3 override changed. User persona contains neither an internal form ID nor a tool name.
user_scenario: Jonas Reed is closing the monthly accounts for Meridian Modelworks Inc. He says, "I need the final August internet-transfer bill for MM-PRODUCTION-LINK issued today. Please handle the account work now; I will personally sign anything that requires my acceptance." He wants the bill actually issued in this conversation. He gives his telephone +12025550161 when asked to locate the account and supplies d4-jonas@meridian.example for a separate verification question; if a further credential is requested he gives 40928163. When the agent asks for the export reference he answers MM-AUG-INTERNET. When asked for a reference for his acceptance he chooses MM-AUG-ACCEPT. He does not know the bill amount and accepts the amount the agent presents. If the agent says a personal confirmation is needed, Jonas says he is ready. Only after the agent explicitly unlocks and hands him a customer tool does he run it with the reference and figure the agent has just presented; he can then repeat the actual receipt if asked. When the agent explains further account work, he says "Please go ahead." Once told the final bill has been issued he replies "Great, that is all I need" and stops, without checking the calculation or asking for another deliverable.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: Caller-supplied phone selects the enterprise profile.
Required recorded identity verification precedes account business.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate MM-PRODUCTION-LINK and read tier, billing entity and approved tax treatment.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The archived comparator is a distinct resource and cannot be billed for this request.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the final source export, pending assessment, and settled prior invoice history. Read the unsigned source-specific authorization form and its stable identifier.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The missing acceptance, pending assessment, and absent source invoice prove the three unmet prerequisites and exclude prior months.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the active matching Support tier.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Its numeric portfolio fraction supplies the acceptance and accounting bounds.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Expose the required user accounting capability.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Customer files acceptance of the presented invoice ceiling.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Select the latest source_subtype primary invoice assessment on this holding by occurred_at; its latest timestamp must be unique, and use that exact review identifier throughout the assisted invoice cycle. Read source_event_id from the exact selected invoice assessment to identify the original source_bundle; an unrelated historical assessment cannot contribute another source. Read the billing period only from the exact posted primary internet_egress source_bundle; the assessment's own period field is not the source of the billing month. Read the posted primary internet_egress quantity for the exact source_bundle identifier and its source_period; cancelled records, other source bundles, other meters and other periods are excluded. Subtract the source tier included_transfer_gb from that period quantity and floor at zero, then multiply by its unit_rate; this gives the undiscounted transfer subtotal. Read portfolio_discount from the unique active Support holding of this customer and billing_entity, using zero if none exists. The invoice acceptance ceiling equals the undiscounted transfer subtotal when promotion_status is eligible; otherwise add a contingency equal to that same subtotal multiplied by the Support fraction. This ceiling is permission only and does not book a charge. When the source tax treatment is verified_exempt the ceiling remains a net amount with no tax uplift; for other supported tax treatments it is still the net ceiling and the statutory tax is separate. Round only this final ceiling half-up to the source tier amount_precision. For an assisted unbilled monthly transfer invoice, the customer personally files one authorization using their exact stated reference after the desk presents this ceiling. Network request status is pending and channel is portal; source_subtype is request. The source event is the provider's whole-month internet_egress export bundle, identified by the invoice assessment source_event_id. This assisted route applies only to the uniquely identified unbilled source bundle whose interval tier matches the current holding tier and whose contract is on-demand with no approved negotiated rate. Its latest invoice assessment names that source bundle explicitly. This invoice route requires source_bundle to be the sole posted primary internet_egress meter for its holding and UTC month, representing the entire month with the holding active throughout it; the full monthly allowance therefore belongs to that source. Its tier, commercial attributes, us_east region and approved tax treatment must match the unchanged current holding attributes. Other monthly sources retain ordinary chronological allocation and are outside this assisted route. The unsigned form for this route is the sole pending network_service_record with source_subtype request, exact source_bundle and related selected_review, empty notice_at and zero net_amount. Its identifier is available from find_network_events before signing. It is a prepared form, not a filed customer request or authorization. Pass that identifier as request_id to the customer-owned filing action. When the customer accepts the presented ceiling, update that same form into a network_request with source_subtype request, status pending, portal channel, the exact customer-stated external_reference, the accepted net_amount, and notice_at and occurred_at from the frozen clock; preserve its event identifier and return it in the actual filing receipt. No accounting balance changes. Only the customer performs this filing; an unsigned form never supplies accepted net to pricing.

request_binding.action_semantics: Select the latest source_subtype primary invoice assessment on this holding by occurred_at; its latest timestamp must be unique, and use that exact review identifier throughout the assisted invoice cycle. Read source_event_id from the exact selected invoice assessment to identify the original source_bundle; an unrelated historical assessment cannot contribute another source. Read the billing period only from the exact posted primary internet_egress source_bundle; the assessment's own period field is not the source of the billing month. Read the posted primary internet_egress quantity for the exact source_bundle identifier and its source_period; cancelled records, other source bundles, other meters and other periods are excluded. Subtract the source tier included_transfer_gb from that period quantity and floor at zero, then multiply by its unit_rate; this gives the undiscounted transfer subtotal. Read portfolio_discount from the unique active Support holding of this customer and billing_entity, using zero if none exists. Sum net_amount only from posted network_charge records with source_subtype primary, pricing_component portfolio, meter_code internet_egress, source_event_id equal to source_bundle and period equal to source_period; only this exact completed net invoice enters the tax base. Use the smaller of that issued net subtotal and the undiscounted source subtotal multiplied by the Support fraction and Network max_resources as the tax base; this is the same assisted posting ceiling and never taxes an unissued amount. For us_taxable use taxable_rate, which is the source tier tax_rates us_taxable entry; for us_untaxed or verified_exempt use zero. Current approved tax evidence must support the source treatment. Multiply that rounded issued-net base by the selected tax rate and round only the final tax component half-up to amount_precision; zero-rate sources have no tax debit. Post exactly one positive network_debit_adjustment with net_amount zero, tax_amount equal to amount, and source_subtype supplemental, linked to the original net invoice. This separately identified statutory tax addition is not a correction of an erroneous invoice. Before completing the tax component of an assisted transfer bill, issue its net-only invoice.
